title: Freecam
description: A simple freecam mod for Ornithe 1.8.9
body:
# Freecam A Freecam Mod for Ornithe 1.8.9
This freecam mod should be undetectable by servers, but this is not guarenteed. Freecam lets you view the world as a spectator and detached ghost from your player. ## Keybinds | Name | Description | Default Keybind | | -------------- | ------------------------ | --------------- | | Toggle Freecam | Enable / Disable Freecam | X | ## Requirements - [Ornithe Standard Libraries](https://modrinth.com/mod/osl) (0.17.2+)
